description:
Utility for mass-downloading LRC synced lyrics for your offline music library

Utility for mass-downloading LRC synced lyrics for your offline music library. LRCGET will scan every files in your chosen directory for music files, then and try to download lyrics to a LRC files having the same name and save them to the same directory as your music files.
Changelog:
- Improved LRCLIB reliability with higher rate limits for LRCGET, automatic retries, and smarter request pacing.
- Added a countdown in the Download window when downloads pause due to rate limits, plus clearer error messages.
- Improved publishing and flagging reliability, including fixing how report reasons are submitted.
- Fixed scanning audio files with large embedded cover art by increasing the metadata allocation limit to 64 MB (#372).
- Updated the word segmentation library to simplify reproducible builds, including NixOS packaging (#407).
- Standardized Linux executable and package filenames to lowercase lrcget, while keeping the display name “LRCGET” (#431).
Thanks to @BrenekH and @LeisureLinux for their contributions!
